behaviors.description: Search independently prepared AppStream description text.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh user remote with A query metadata.
behaviors.expected: A-only keyword returns exactly Query; B-only and missing keywords return no matches; no deployments.

behaviors.description: Filter mixed AppStream results by the Flatpak bundle ref kind.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh user remote with independently exported matching and nonmatching app and runtime components; search help advertises both kind options.
behaviors.expected: Default and both flags return exactly the matching app and runtime; each single flag returns only its kind; nonmatching controls and absent keywords never match; no refs are deployed. Missing kind options are explicitly unsupported, not passing.

mappings.rationale: Unique description-only keyword matches exactly the prepared app ID, with B-only and nonexistent terms excluded.
Exact mixed-kind results distinguish the default, each individual kind filter, and their union without adding a behavior requirement.

surface_assertions.rationale: App-only excludes the independently matching runtime; adding --runtime restores both matching refs, with nonmatching controls excluded.
Runtime-only excludes the independently matching app; adding --app restores both matching refs, with nonmatching controls excluded.
